lines: I was sprinting briskly through the darkness on my own.
「Hahahahahaha!! Who'd get caught by you, morooonnns?!!」
I was right in the middle of a mission to bust and wipe out a wide-reaching slave trader group called the Black Scarves.
The ones currently chasing me with enraged expressions were the orc thugs who were members of it.

I had stealthily infiltrated their hideout, and had been searching around to try and get a hold of their secret transaction ledger, when, owing to an inadvertent slip-up, I had been discovered by them, and forced into an
（Well, the old me would've been trembling and saying stuff like 『Whoooaaa?! This is baaaaad!!』, though......）
I thought with a smirk, as I calmly escaped.
That would be unthinkable now. I was perfectly composed.
I had gotten through difficult missions countless times by now, and these days, I was diligently racking up the combat training, too.
No matter if I was being chased by thugs like these, the new me was always calm and collected, with no reason to get the slightest bit flustered――
The fierce sound of something whooshing through the air was approaching me from behind.
It was a gigantic battle axe thrown by the high orc who appeared to be the thugs' boss.
I promptly dodged it by rolling along the ground, at which point it flew past right above my head, and embedded itself in the outer wall of a building, making a violent metallic clang.
The outer wall of the building the axe had stuck into collapsed, blocking my path with countless pieces of debris.
I took it all back. No matter what I said, the power of the denizens of the underworld was terrifying.
「Guhihi...... Looks like our game of tag is over, kid.」
「Yeah...... I'm surprised. I never thought the Black Scarves would have a tough guy like you.」
That said, if I showed anxiety here, it would just be taken advantage of.
I got to my feet with a composed expression, and faced off against the surrounding orcs.
「Geh hi hi hi. Don't underestimate our gang, boy.」

「Under the leadership of His Excellency, Supreme Leader Muffler White, he of the jet-black scarf that glimmers in the darkness, we've put together a group of elite warriors who are each a match for a thousand men!」
「Eh? Really? Despite that, they say you kowtow to Nomad, though......」
The orcs flinched, and made uneasy faces.
「Story goes, you even get pushed around by Chinese Union refugees. Matter of fact――」
「We have intel that you've been crying over having your turf grabbed by some new organization that's emerged recently......」
That “new organization” meant Gaiza's, which had broken off from Gosha, so from my standpoint, I had kind of mixed feelings, though.
「Sh-Shuddup!!! Our whole selling point is our surprisingly compact organizational structure!!」

「Right, right!」
「We're not gettin' beat!!」
「It's workstyle reform, dipshit!!」
The orcs were making a racket, arguing back.
I didn't really get it, but I supposed underworld circles must have it tough in a lot of ways too.
「A-Anyway!!! If anyone gets their hands on our account book, I'll never be able to face the Supreme Leader!!」
「I'm gonna take my time findin' out who's backing you—by asking your body directly!!」
The orcs made their eyes gleam with murderous intent, and slowly narrowed their circle around me.
They were denizens of the criminal underworld, who had demonic power and physical strength far beyond that of a human being.
Behind me was blocked up with debris, and there was no escape.
It was a desperate situation for sure, but――
「Kuku, but...... that's if you can, though, right?」
I grinned at the enraged orcs, and the next moment――

「Wh-What the??!」
「An explosion?! It's from the direction of our base!!」
A thunderous roar reverberated all around.
The orcs were in a commotion.
The source of the explosion sound was near the abandoned building that the group were using as their hideout.
At that point, a transmission came in on my communicator, in a girl's voice.
『Hyeeeeeh?!! Fuuma-kun! The explosion, the gunpowder, it's way bigger than I thought!!』
『I-It's a success!! I got all the papers in the safe!!! Plus, the base is in an uproar from the bomb!!』
The person on the other end of the call was my partner for this mission, Mochizuki Una.

The plan was for me to intentionally get caught by the orcs to draw their attention and serve as a decoy, and then have Una, who was in charge of infiltrating, swing into action once the base had become insufficiently guarded.
「Shit!! If only we could've secured enough personnel for the base!!」
「To use our own staff shortage against us... You're a hell of a tactician, aren'tcha, you asshole?!!」
「W-Well, I wasn't really thinking about your staff shortage, but......」
“Underworld circles must have it tough in a lot of ways too, huh?” I thought again.
「A-Anyway!! Now it's come to this, there's nothin' for it. We're at least gonna slaughter you, no matter what――」
「――I won't let you do that! Eih!! Earth Escape: Terra Blast!!!」
All of a sudden, the ground at the orcs' feet rose up, and several of them were sent flying at once.
「That's Mari-chan-senpai for you. In that case, I――」
They swooped down upon the confused orcs, and covered them with wounds in a flash.
Two girls nimbly landed on either side of me.
The ambush party I had prepared, to wipe the orcs out after I lured them out as a decoy.
These two were also my trusty partners for this mission.
「Nugugu......! So what if the number of kids has gone up by two?!!」
「I don't care! Slaughter all these brats at onnnnce!!」
